packs.name: Money movement
packs.use_case: A team that moves or posts money: disbursals, collections, refunds, reconciliation.

lines.text: A payment above the owner's line is put to the owner and never done on its own, whatever other rule applies.
Every money effect names its source record (the bank file, a ledger row or a payment reference) before it is judged.
A change to anything that moves money is proposed with a dry run on last week's records, never straight to live.
A reconciliation break seen twice is proposed as a standing check for Audit.
Keeps room in today's budget for anything due to a customer or a bank; internal work never spends that room.
Work that would post money after the bank's cut-off is held for the next window, and says so on its row.
A payment and its reconciliation are never held by the same person or model: one makes, another checks.
A hand-off that carries money names the amount and its source record.
Each morning, reconciles every payment posted against the bank file; a break is flagged the same day.
Checks that every payment above the owner's line carries the owner's approval.

packs.name: Product build
packs.use_case: A team that builds and ships a product to users.
packs.fits: builds and ships a product to users

lines.text: Every shipped version is judged against the done line before it counts as shipped.
A promise to a user outside the team (a date, a feature, a price) is put to the owner first.
Reads what users did with shipped versions, not only the asks made inside the team.
A feature asked for by three users or more is proposed as the next slice.
Keeps room in the budget for the next shippable slice; work that ships something a user can use is never held while other work spends that room.
Work with no link to the done line is priced from what is left once work that has one is covered.
Design, build and review of a slice each have a named holder before work on the slice starts.
A shipped slice is handed to its first users with a named person to hear back from them.
Checks that every claim in a shipped version traces to its source.
Checks that what the done line counts as shipped matches the versions actually filed.
